_comment: WITH SSH OFF (the current state) use FTPS:
npm run publish            # build + upload + verify
npm run publish:dry        # show what would change, upload nothing
Credentials go in .env.deploy (git-ignored): FTP_HOST, FTP_USER, FTP_PASSWORD.
Get them from hPanel -> Files -> FTP Accounts.
The SFTP route below needs SSH enabled and is kept for if it ever is.
config.js and knet/config.php are NEVER uploaded and NEVER deleted by either
route - they hold the live Supabase and Tranportal credentials and exist only

ftp._note: host/user also readable from FTP_HOST / FTP_USER in .env.deploy, which win
